## November 12, 2026: Updated RFQ Page Now in beta


## **Updated RFQ Page**


*Now in beta*


The updated RFQ page is now in beta and available to all users. Here is a look at what is new and how it helps you get better quotes.


**What has changed:**


The RFQ page now includes a request details panel on the right side of the page. Before you submit, you can tell our sourcing team:


- **Why you want quotes:** Choose a reason, such as better pricing, better lead time, or parts that are not buyable through Cofactr.
- **Who you want quotes sourced from:** Select any combination of authorized distributors, manufacturers, and independent distributors or brokers.
- **Target delivery date, program, application, and estimated annual usage:** Give our team the context behind your request.
- **Notes:** Add delivery schedules, specific supplier preferences, or anything else our team should know.


You can also set a target price on each line of your RFQ. Every line defaults to Best Available.


**Why it changed:**


The more our sourcing team knows about a request up front, the faster and more accurately we can quote it. The new panel puts those details into the RFQ itself, so your requirements travel with every request.


**What problem it solves:**


- **Quotes from the right channels:** Our team requests quotes only from the sourcing channels you select, so every quote meets your requirements.
- **Faster turnaround:** With your reason, target delivery date, and application in hand, our team can act on your RFQ right away.
- **Stronger negotiating position:** Sharing your estimated annual usage and delivery schedule helps us negotiate on your behalf.


**What it looks like in the platform:**


Add parts to an RFQ, then fill in the request details panel on the right before you click Submit RFQ. Once submitted, your RFQ page shows the allowed sourcing channels, target delivery date, and the reason for sourcing at the top of the page, so you can confirm your requirements at a glance.


Since this feature is in beta, we would love to hear from you. If you have any questions or feedback, please reach out to your Customer Success contact.


## November 5: Updated RFQ Page


## **Updated RFQ Page**


*Coming soon*


The RFQ page is getting a new section that gives our sourcing team the context they need to act on your request right away, so you get usable quotes back faster.


- **Request details:** Before you submit, a panel on the right side of the page will ask why you want quotes and who you want them sourced from, so your RFQ only goes through sourcing channels that meet your requirements.
- **Target delivery date, program, and application:** Sharing these up front means fewer clarifying questions from our team and quotes that are more likely to fit your needs.
- **Notes:** Add anything else our sourcing team should know, including specific supplier preferences.
- **Target price:** Set the price you are aiming for on each line. Every line defaults to Best Available.


Questions about what is changing? Please reach out to your Customer Success contact.


## October 28, 2026: Attrition Explainer


## **Attrition Explainer**


*Now available to all customers*


The Attrition Explainer shows how overage amounts are calculated, so you can see the reasoning behind each number directly in the platform.


- **Programs view:** Hover over the overage column to see how the amount was calculated, with a link to a help article for more detail.
- **Organization Settings:** The Attrition Models tab displays the full model rules, including minimum and target attrition by package type and price.


Whether you are checking a single line or reviewing your full model, the reasoning behind your overages is always one click away.


## October 22, 2026: Custom High-Value Critical Services shipping option


## **Custom High-Value Critical Services shipping option**


#### *Now available to all customers*


For kits containing parts that are especially valuable, critical, or difficult to replace, you can now select Custom High-Value Critical Services (CHVC) when creating a kit. You will find it in the Custom High-Value Critical section of the shipping dropdown.


When you choose CHVC, the Cofactr team coordinates directly with you to arrange the right packaging and carrier for the shipment. Options include:


- **Carrier services:** local rush courier, airline counter-to-counter, time-definite critical, next flight out, international critical, expedited ground, dedicated charter, secure and monitored transport, and hand carry or on-board courier
- **Coverage:** enhanced high-value insurance
- **Packaging:** custom wood crates, rotomolded cases, round-trip totes, rigid bulk containers, 500 lb double-wall boxes, and tamper-evident security seals, which can be paired with any carrier option


Standard UPS, FedEx, and DHL services remain available for all kits.


#### **Attrition Explainer**
*Beta: available to select customers*


The Attrition Explainer shows how overage amounts are calculated, so you can understand the reasoning behind each number directly in the platform.


- **Organization Settings:** A new Attrition Models tab displays the full model rules, including minimum and target attrition by package type and price.


The Attrition Explainer is currently available to customers in our beta group, with broader availability to follow.


## October 15, 2026: Compliance Profiles are now in beta


This week, Compliance Profiles went into beta with a small group of aerospace and defense design partners. Every program comes with its own set of rules, and Compliance Profiles let teams see, manage, and build on their purchase rules themselves, with as many profiles as they need, like a looser one for prototyping and a stricter one for production.


We are working closely with this group to get it right before it rolls out more broadly. Watch this page for availability.
